item.title: Teton Pass reopens after avalanche cleanup
item.description: WILSON, Wyo. — Commuters, rejoice! WY22 over Teton Pass has reopened to traffic following a 14-hour closure due to an avalanche blocking the road. The Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT) announced that the road opened just after 5 p.m. on Monday.
